mug_dana: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for early morning, but today at 07:32 it was at desk_o1. The "cupboard_k1 pre-09:00" heuristic is unreliable; mugs are often at desk_o1 before work starts. Check desk_o1 for mugs before 09:00.

glass_dana (mid-day): Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but today at 12:54 it was at kitchen_table_k1. The "desk_o1 09:00-17:00" heuristic is inconsistent for glasses; they frequently move to kitchen_table_k1 during lunch breaks. Check kitchen_table_k1 for glasses between 12:00 and 14:00.

glass_dana (late night): Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night, but today at 22:06 it was at counter_k1. The "nightstand_b1 post-20:00" heuristic is unreliable; glasses are often at counter_k1 in the evening. Check counter_k1 for glasses after 20:00.

glasses_dana (late night): Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late night, but today at 22:21 it was at nightstand_b1. The "desk_o1 post-17:00" heuristic is unreliable; glasses return to nightstand_b1 in the evening. Check nightstand_b1 for glasses after 20:00.

General Pattern: Location is highly time-dependent and object-specific. Pre-09:00: check desk_o1 for mugs and bathroom_shelf_ba1 for glasses. 09:00-12:00: check desk_o1 for glasses and water bottles. 12:00-14:00: check kitchen_table_k1 for glasses. 14:00-17:00: check desk_o1 for glasses and water bottles. Post-18:00: check kitchen_table_k1 for water bottles, counter_k1 for glasses, and nightstand_b1 for glasses. Do not default to desk_o1 for all items during work hours or nightstand_b1 for all items at night.
